# Version 4.148.1 (Unreleased)
> **macOS typeface race fix**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.1 fixes a data race in macOS typeface stream access.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **macOS typeface stream access is synchronized** — The bundled m148 engine picks up an upstream fix for the gTFCache and fStream race in SkTypeface_Mac. ([#4262](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4262))
